meta.description: Jahaan farmeet aur faree kanvenshnon men nae log nae dost banaate hain. Global Furry Television kee or se.
site.name: GFTV HelloSpot
official.line: Global Furry Television kee ek aadhikaarik vebsaait
official.domain-heading: GFTV kee aadhikaarik saaiten globalfurry.tv yaa gftv.asia par khatm hotee hain
official.domain-body: Pataa ant se parhen: Pahle akele slaish se pahle vaale aakhiree bindu par dekhen. Kisee aur cheez par khatm hone vaalee saait GFTV kee naheen hai, bhale hee pate men pahle yah naam dikhe.
official.trusted-link: GFTV kee aadhikaarik saaiton kee pooree soochee
official.secure-heading: Surkshit saaiten HTTPS kaa istemaal kartee hain
official.secure-body: Taale kaa nishaan yaa pate kee shuruaat men https:// dekhen. Nijee jaankaaree keval surkshit kanekshan par kisee aadhikaarik saait par hee saajhaa karen.
update.label: Apdet
update.ready: GFTV HelloSpot kaa nayaa sanskaran taiyaar hai.
hero.card-alt: HelloSpot naam kaard. Is par ek baree muskaan ke paas Hello aur 哈喽 likhaa hai, peechhe GFTV kee indradhnushee dhaariyaan hain.
hero.title: Aapko ek HelloSpot mil gayaa!
hero.lede: Farmeet aur faree kanvenshnon men, HelloSpot vah jagah hai jahaan nae log nae dost banaate hain.
how.title: HelloSpot kaise kaam kartaa hai
how.spot.title: Muskaan dhoonrhen
how.spot.body: Kisee kaard, lainyaard yaa saainbord par HelloSmile dhoonrhen. Vah jahaan bhee ho, vahee HelloSpot hai.
how.hello.title: Namste kahen
how.hello.body: Paas aaie aur haay kahie. HelloSpot par koee ummeed naheen kartaa ki aap pahle se kisee ko jaante hon.
how.friend.title: Dost banaaen
how.friend.body: Apne aaspaas ke logon se milen, aur aglee meet men dhoonrhne ke lie ek dost lekar jaaen.
gallery.title: HelloSpot par bane dost
takagi.when.title: Takagi kab?
takagi.when.body: Har meet isee savaal par khatm hotee hai.
takagi.now.title: Takagi abhee!!
takagi.now.body: Theek hai, ab kab-kab poochhnaa band karo.
takagi.eaten.title: Takagi khaa liyaa.
takagi.eaten.body: Aglee meet men phir isee samay?
takagi.photo-1: Ek tre men raamen kaa katoraa aur alag se noodals, paas men ek chhotaa Eevee khilaunaa
takagi.photo-2: Chopstik aur do chhote salaad ke saath Takagi Ramen kaa tekave ordar
takagi.photo-3: Ek tre men raamen, alag se noodals, fraaid chikan aur salaad
takagi.photo-4: Ek tre men pork raamen kaa katoraa, gyozaa aur aaisd tee
takagi.photo-5: Chopstik, atirikt noodals aur aaisd leman tee ke saath raamen kaa ek katoraa
takagi.photo-6: Takagi Express kee dukaan kaa saamne vaalaa hissaa, kaauntar par laal stool
about.title: Global Furry Television
about.body-1: Global Furry Television (GFTV) Singaapur men sthit, Eshiyaa kaa sabse baraa faree faindam samaachaar chainal hai.
about.body-2: Ham faree samudaay ke vikaas ko saamne laate hain taaki aaj aur kal har koee uskee saraahnaa kar sake, aur ham aisee jaghen banaate hain jahaan log ek-doosre ke baare men jaan aur samajh saken.
about.body-3: Ghar se shuroo hokar pramukh mahaadveepon tak phailee GFTV kee teem antarraashtreey, bahusaanskritik aur bahubhaashee hai.
outro.title: Agle HelloSpot par milte hain!
